title: Why isn't my QR code scanning?
summary: Explains why a QR code may not scan and how to fix it: the code expires if generated more than 17 (time units not specified), display glare/low brightness, camera focus issues (distance/motion/dirty lens), and QR issues (cropped/distorted/low quality/compressed/edited). Also covers enabling camera permissions and reopening the scanner.
